decisions.decision: Corrected spec 050 Context/Assumptions sections rather than treating the spec as accurate before planning
decisions.why: The spec Context claim (no multiline text entry point exists) was already false when written 2026-07-27 - pb_text_sample/pb_text_sample_review already existed since commit 7b262941, predating this spec by weeks. On closer inspection the review step is a plain bool yes/no gate, not the per-character attributed proposal UI spec 044 introduced, so the real remaining gap is larger than the original US2-only (file upload) framing implied
decisions.rejected: Planning the spec as originally written, which would have re-derived already-shipped US1 mechanics and understated the real scope of US1s propose-then-confirm acceptance criteria (FR-005/FR-006)

decisions.decision: Target TextSamplePlaceholder on the build-list page, not the older pb_text_sample/pb_text_sample_review chain
decisions.why: TextSamplePlaceholders own code comment names spec 050 as its owner and cites spec 044 FR-016b as reserving the slot; the older chain predates the build-list unification and is reachable only via a non-default manual path
decisions.rejected: Retrofitting pb_text_sample_review with attribution/union logic, which would leave the actually-reserved, default-path placeholder unbuilt

decisions.decision: Integrate via addProposed(char, source:text) per character, not seedFromProposal
decisions.why: SourcedInventory.source is typed ExemplarSource (cldr|sldr only), structurally excluding text; DraftProvenance already includes text specifically for addProposed callers
decisions.rejected: Widening ExemplarSource to include text and routing through seedFromProposal, which would touch exemplar-sourcing engine code for no benefit

decisions.decision: Route text-sample proposals through the existing addProposed per-character action instead of building a new seedFromText batch action
decisions.why: addProposed already exists, is already provenance-aware and union-safe, and DraftProvenance already has a text member anticipating this exact feature - verified directly against phaseBDraftStore.ts
decisions.rejected: A new seedFromText(chars) batch action mirroring seedFromProposals shape, which would have duplicated logic addProposed already provides

concerns.note: FR-001/002/004 (multiline paste + harvestChars extraction) are already shipped via pb_text_sample, predating this spec. FR-003 (file upload) and FR-005/006/007 (044-contract propose-then-confirm, per-character attribution, union with exemplar coverage) remain genuinely unbuilt - the review step needs to be rebuilt against 044s actual mechanism, not just wired to it. This is closer to net-new work than the original spec framing implied.

approach: Wire the existing, reserved TextSamplePlaceholder to a real paste/upload affordance using harvestFromText (extraction) and addProposed with source:text (union/attribution) - both already exist, DraftProvenance already anticipates text. UI + thin adapter only, no store/engine changes.

plan.summary: Wire the reserved TextSamplePlaceholder to harvestFromText + addProposed(source:text); no store/engine changes needed, both already anticipate this feature
plan.key_finding: DraftProvenance already has a text member and addProposed already documents the exact union/attribution contract FR-005/006/007 need - this is a UI task, not a state-design task
